{"format":"org.dxos.dx-svg@1","version":1,"root":"0000000000000AFV7QDE7CQVPT","source":{"language":"dsl","text":"diagram @ -128,-64 flow=down box=256x128 grid=384x256
group clients "Clients" {
  node Composer "Composer" ref="packages/apps/composer-app" color=blue
  node Cli "hub-cli" ref="edge/packages/apps/hub-cli"
}
group gateway "Gateway" {
  node Router "edge router" ref="edge/packages/services/edge/wrangler.jsonc" color=orange
  node Hub "hub (accounts)" ref="edge/packages/services/hub-service/wrangler.jsonc"
}
group services "Services" compact color=light-violet {
  node Db "db-service" ref="edge/packages/services/db-service/wrangler.jsonc" color=green
  node Compute "compute-service" ref="edge/packages/services/compute-service/wrangler.jsonc" color=light-red
  node Identity "identity-service" ref="edge/packages/services/identity-service/wrangler.jsonc"
  node Kms "kms-service" ref="edge/packages/services/kms-service/wrangler.jsonc"
  node Ai "ai-service" ref="edge/packages/services/ai-service/wrangler.jsonc" color=violet
  node Blob "blob-service" ref="edge/packages/services/blob-service/wrangler.jsonc"
  node Store "KV / R2 / D1 / Q" ref="edge/packages/services/edge/wrangler.jsonc"
}
edge Composer -> Router "WebSocket + HTTP"
edge Cli -> Router "HTTP API"
edge Composer -> Hub "passkey login"
edge Router -> Hub "auth lookup"
edge Router -> Db "/db"
edge Router -> Compute "/functions"
edge Router -> Identity "/identity"
edge Router -> Kms "/kms"
edge Router -> Ai "/ai"
edge Router -> Blob "/blob"
edge Db -> Compute "functions"
edge Db -> Kms
edge Compute -> Ai
edge Hub -> Db "data"
edge Router -> Store "queues, backups"
"},"objects":[
